properties.name: arconia.bootstrap.profiles.enabled
properties.description: Whether to activate profiles based on the bootstrap mode. Resolved before the application configuration is loaded, so it is only supported in the META-INF/arconia-bootstrap.properties file, as a JVM system property, as an environment variable, or as a command line argument.

properties.name: arconia.dev.profiles
properties.description: Names of the profiles to activate in dev mode. Resolved before the application configuration is loaded, so it is only supported in the META-INF/arconia-bootstrap.properties file, as a JVM system property, as an environment variable, or as a command line argument.

properties.description: Names of the profiles to activate in test mode. Resolved before the application configuration is loaded, so it is only supported in the META-INF/arconia-bootstrap.properties file, as a JVM system property, as an environment variable, or as a command line argument.
